summary: DIYhomie MVP fully tested. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (1 skipped — out-of-credits drain is too costly to validate via real LLM). Verified register/login/me, profile update, project CRUD, AI step generation (gpt-4o-mini fallback, returns valid JSON shape with step_title/text_instruction/visual_description/missing_tools/code_alert), text/voice credit deduction (1 vs 2), gpt-image-1 image generation (base64, ~12s), Amazon affiliate supplies + bundle URL, community post→reply→author-only verify with +10 credits / +2 voice min payout, mock billing tier grants, and invalid-tier 400. Frontend E2E (390x844 viewport): Onboarding → 5-card Survey → Auth register → Paywall (Start Trial) → Tabs all navigate cleanly. Home: typing 'Fix leaky kitchen faucet' creates project, shows first step 'Turn off the water supply under the sink.', step image renders, credit meter toggles 'TEXT ECO · 60 cr' → 'VOICE 2x · 59 cr'. Supplies tab shows empty state + Bark hire-pro card. Community: FAB → compose → post creation works and lists. Profile shows credits/voice min, location save, upgrade, logout. testIDs are comprehensive. No critical bugs.

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt version warning in logs (`AttributeError: module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'`). Auth still works; cosmetic only. Pin `bcrypt<4.1` or upgrade passlib to silence.

issues: DM Sans font files fail to decode on web preview ('OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion: 168430090' for DMSans-Regular/Medium/Bold.ttf). UI falls back to system fonts and still looks correct, but custom typography is not applied on web. Verify font binaries are valid TTF and not LFS pointers/HTML 404 pages.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (RN Web deprecation.)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Update component(s) using pointerEvents as a prop.

action_items: (Optional) Pin `bcrypt<4.1` in backend/requirements.txt to silence harmless passlib warning.
Fix DM Sans .ttf assets (re-export valid TTF) so custom typography applies on web preview as well.
Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` (or wrap with Platform.select for native vs web).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 516-line file — acceptable for MVP, but split into routers (auth, projects, community, billing) before scaling.
GET /api/projects strips `steps` field — good for list performance. GET /api/projects/{id} excludes `_id` — good.
brain_generate concatenates entire history each call; consider trimming or summarizing on long sessions to control token cost.
Out-of-credits returns 402 with proper detail string — verified by code review (not by live drain test).
All endpoints require Bearer auth (verified via 401/403 negative test).
Project ownership enforced via `user_id` filter in every query — good multi-tenant isolation.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed users/posts (uuid-suffixed). Not cleaned up — disposable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brain is in fallback mode (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) since PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is empty — this is expected. Step image generation takes ~10-15s. Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_diyhomie_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. UI testIDs are comprehensive (see survey-option-{value}, home-input, home-send-button, home-step-instruction, home-credit-meter, paywall-start-trial, etc).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only minor cosmetic warnings (fonts/deprecations) documented above.
